evidence: Single-table DayZ validation returned no exception for multi-table metadata when the relationships key was removed.
Multi-table DayZ validation raised AttributeError ('str' object has no attribute 'keys') for relationships=['a', 'b', 'c'] instead of a structured validation error.
steps: Created a multi-table Metadata object with district/account tables and one relationship.
Built a valid DayZ parameter dictionary and removed relationships for the single-table path.
Called SingleTableDayZSynthesizer.validate_parameters(metadata, parameters) and observed no exception.
Set relationships to ['a', 'b', 'c'] and called MultiTableDayZSynthesizer.validate_parameters(metadata, parameters), observing AttributeError.
Set min_cardinality to 0 and verified the multi-table validator accepted it.
